patchNotes: See docs/P4-REVIEW.md and docs/P4-R2.md. Architect token boundary applies injected network policy and removes raw server/network details while preserving cancellation and wire fields. Original/non-quota commit/device/quality fields, hash query and native-pair metadata remain pinned. See docs/P4-B-INTEGRATION.md.
